content.value_statement: Cold outreach needs relevant messages, verified addresses, and careful follow-up. This skill guides BeReach list preparation, persona-based drafting, and user review before manual sending.
actual_capabilities: Group BeReach contacts by persona, flag uncertain matches, and exclude do-not-contact records.
Request verified work email lookups in batches of up to 25 after cost approval.
Draft three or four emails per persona using one offer and a suggested day 1, 4, 8, and 14 schedule.
Personalize drafts with dated contact facts or clearly marked role-based alternatives without inventing evidence.
Prepare review pages, copy-ready email blocks, and CSV handover content with country-specific footer guidance.
Update outreach tags, record opt-outs, and compare mature batches using counts supplied by the user.
limitations: Requires available BeReach tools and account access; missing persona or voice cards depend on companion skills.
Email lookup and signal enrichment can consume credits after approval; verified addresses are not guaranteed.
Does not send, schedule, or read mailbox emails; users send drafts and provide replies or results.
Cannot guarantee delivery, replies, or legal compliance; users must verify current rules and handle consent and suppression.

use_cases.title: Prepare a founder's first outreach batch
use_cases.description: Turn a BeReach prospect list and a concrete service offer into reviewed drafts with verified addresses and clear spending checkpoints.

use_cases.title: Standardize persona-based sales sequences
use_cases.description: Build separate sequences for buyer groups, apply a shared voice, and exclude ambiguous or previously contacted prospects.

use_cases.title: Review consulting outreach results
use_cases.description: Use supplied reply and bounce counts to assess mature batches and select one message change for the next test.

prompt_templates.title: Check sending readiness
prompt_templates.prompt: Check readiness for cold outreach from [work mailbox] to recipients in [countries]. Ask about authentication, daily volume, and tracking before preparing the sending check.

prompt_templates.title: Create a persona sequence
prompt_templates.prompt: Draft a four-email sequence for [persona] offering [existing deliverable] in [language]. Use [voice examples], one offer, and a clear opt-out. Ask for missing facts.
prompt_templates.scenario: Intermediate: prepare reusable templates for review.

prompt_templates.title: Prepare an approved contact batch
prompt_templates.prompt: Prepare outreach for BeReach list [campaignId] using [offering] and [voice card]. Present persona matches and credit ceilings before spending. Use verified addresses and dated facts. Show drafts for approval before handover.
prompt_templates.scenario: Advanced: coordinate lookup, personalization, and review.

prompt_templates.title: Evaluate results and plan one test
prompt_templates.prompt: Review [batch dates] and [sent, replies, interested replies, bounces, opt-outs]. Exclude batches younger than seven days from rates. Show no rates below ten sent. Propose one change within [persona] without estimating missing counts.
prompt_templates.scenario: Advanced: compare mature outreach batches using supplied evidence.

output_examples.input: Hypothetical readiness check: work mailbox, 120 planned emails daily, tracking enabled, authentication not confirmed, and US recipients.
output: Needs correction: reduce daily volume to no more than 50 and disable tracking.
Needs confirmation: check SPF, DKIM, and DMARC results before sending.
US footer: include sender identity, a valid postal address, a commercial notice, and an opt-out in every email.
Sending remains your responsibility; no emails have been sent.

output_examples.input: Hypothetical draft: Sam sells energy audits, offers an existing heating checklist, and writes to UK company facilities manager Alex without a recent personal fact.
output: Personalization: role-based alternative; no recent personal fact supplied.

Hello Alex,
Heating settings can remain unchanged when a building moves to a new facilities team. I am Sam, an energy auditor for commercial buildings. I have a checklist for reviewing those settings before the next billing cycle, with checks your team can use on site. Would you like the heating checklist?

Sam, [Company]
Not relevant? Reply no and I will not write again.
Review required: confirm the recipient's role, verified address, sender details, and the checklist before sending.

best_practices: Confirm persona fit, opt-out status, and credit ceilings before approving enrichment or email lookup.
Use only supported facts and available offers; replace missing personal facts with clearly identified role-based context.
Verify local outreach rules and mailbox authentication, disable tracking, and stop follow-ups immediately when a recipient replies.
anti_patterns: Using guessed addresses, fabricated personal events, unsupported results, or offers that do not exist.
Treating draft handover or contact tags as proof that an email was actually sent.
Continuing a sequence after a reply, bypassing opt-outs, or increasing volume to compensate for poor targeting.

faq.question: Does this skill send emails?
faq.answer: No. It prepares drafts for your mailbox or email tool. BeReach LinkedIn messaging tools must not be used to send these emails.

faq.question: What do I need to use the full workflow?
faq.answer: You need BeReach tool access, a contact list, an offering, and voice guidance. Missing persona or voice cards require companion skills.

faq.question: When are credits used?
faq.answer: Email lookup charges for found addresses, and signal enrichment may also cost credits. The workflow presents costs and requires approval before spending.

faq.question: What happens when no verified email is available?
faq.answer: The contact is skipped for sending. The skill does not substitute a guessed or unverified address.

faq.question: Does the skill change BeReach records?
faq.answer: Yes. It adds persona and outreach tags, saves approved templates, and marks opt-outs as do-not-contact. Existing tags and notes should be preserved.

faq.question: Does it guarantee compliant outreach or better results?
faq.answer: No. It provides legal and deliverability guidance, not legal advice or performance guarantees. You remain responsible for current rules, sending, and honoring opt-outs.
